character.description: Glossy cocoa black-sesame macaron courier with cream face, large brown eyes, white jeweled baker toque, and shiny berry-red scarf.

chroma_key.name: green
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 3 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: Subtle breathing and one blink, with both feet planted; keep the body in place.

run.action: An eight-frame seamless rightward running cycle. The first and eighth poses should be near-matching right-foot-forward contact poses so the loop closes cleanly; between them show alternating foot contacts, passing poses and airborne phases with opposite arm swings and scarf trailing left. Keep anatomy stable.

jump.action: A complete short jump: crouch, takeoff, compact airborne pose, then landing recovery; distinct readable silhouette in each frame.

slide.action: A low forward slide under an obstacle: standing anticipation, body tucked close to the ground with scarf streaming behind, held low pose, then rise; keep the whole character visible.

attack.action: An energetic forward magic strike: brief windup, decisive rightward punch with one arm, held strike, recovery; no detached effects or props.

style: Polished glossy soft 3D mobile game render matching the accepted idle image.
